methodology.selection: Latest adopted or officially published municipal budget available on 2026-08-20 for every EU capital plus London.
methodology.canonical_value: The broadest expenditure total stated or derivable from the official source, with the source-specific scope retained in each record.
methodology.comparison_warning: Municipal structures and accounting conventions differ. Values are suitable for discovery and display, not a league table without applying the scope fields.
methodology.valletta_exception: Valletta's published 2026 PDF contains only a cover and contents page. The latest complete official budget, 2025, is used and flagged.

cities.scope: Municipality of Amsterdam budget
cities.notes: Official city page reports a rounded EUR 7.8 billion 2026 budget. The balance uses the source's narrower table excluding reserves and therefore is not calculated from the displayed headline.

fiscal_details.balance_note_en: Before reserve movements, the 2026 budget has a EUR 130.8 million deficit on EUR 7.18 billion of revenue and EUR 7.31 billion of expenditure. Reserve withdrawals and additions bring the adopted result after appropriations to zero; the city separately reports a EUR 189.7 million structural surplus.
fiscal_details.balance_note_cs: Před pohyby rezerv vykazuje rozpočet na rok 2026 schodek 130,8 mil. EUR při příjmech 7,18 mld. EUR a výdajích 7,31 mld. EUR. Čerpání a tvorba rezerv upraví schválený výsledek po přídělech na nulu; město samostatně uvádí strukturální přebytek 189,7 mil. EUR.

cities.scope: City of Paris; combined commune and department
cities.notes: Uses real expenditure and includes debt repayment in investment spending; components allow a financing-excluded view later.

fiscal_details.balance_note_en: Paris calls this result gross savings: EUR 10.20 billion of real operating revenue less EUR 9.41 billion of real operating expenditure, leaving EUR 797.6 million available before investment financing. It is not a company profit or a total-budget surplus.

benchmark_methodology.population: Latest available Eurostat City Statistics observation for total population on 1 January. The city label and reference year are retained because several countries report a greater-city boundary or an older vintage.
benchmark_methodology.tourism: 2024 nights in tourist accommodation establishments for selected cities, NACE I551-I553, from Eurostat. Dublin and London use official local fallbacks because those cities are absent from the Eurostat selected-city table.
benchmark_methodology.comparison_warning: Eurostat tourist nights cover registered accommodation establishments and may exclude small establishments. Dublin and London fallbacks cover a broader visitor-survey universe and belong to a different comparability group.
benchmark_methodology.derived_metrics: Non-resident share is non-resident nights divided by total nights. Nights per resident divides the tourism-period nights by the latest available population and is flagged when reference years differ.
